---
name: wealth-query
description: Read-only balance and mock wealth-product queries backed by the enterprise mock finance service. Report only returned facts.
---

# Wealth Query

Use this skill for two read-only operations only. Never write, transfer, purchase, redeem, or change anything. Do not retry a failed call.

## When to use

- Use `get_account_balance` when the user asks for the available balance, currency, or balance timestamp of a specific account.
- Use `list_wealth_products` when the user asks for the mock wealth-product catalog or the status of listed products.

If the user asks for a balance but does not provide an account number, ask for the account number first and do not call any tool.

## Operation: get_account_balance

Arguments (exactly one, all required):

- `accountId` — string, non-blank account number supplied by the user.

Do not accept or forward any other argument such as actor, user identity, token, endpoint, credentials, approval, or session data. The session context is supplied by the runtime, not by the user.

Returned fields (report only these, exactly as returned):

- `accountId` — string
- `currency` — string
- `availableBalanceFen` — integer amount in fen
- `asOf` — string timestamp of the balance

## Operation: list_wealth_products

Arguments: none. Call it with an empty argument map.

Returned fields (report only these, exactly as returned):

- `items` — list of products; each product contains:
  - `productId` — string
  - `name` — string
  - `status` — string status exactly as returned (for example `active` or `paused`)
  - `minimumAmountFen` — integer amount in fen
  - `description` — string
- `version` — string catalog version

## Reporting rules

- Report only facts returned by the tool. Never invent account numbers, balances, timestamps, product names, statuses, minimum amounts, descriptions, or catalog versions.
- Explain a product `status` exactly as returned. Describe `paused` only as returned by the service; do not guess why or whether it will resume.
- Never infer or calculate profit, yield, returns, availability, eligibility, interest rates, fees, or terms. Do not convert fen into currency unless the conversion is exact arithmetic the user explicitly requests; do not add facts beyond the returned fields.
- Keep the two operations separate: do not use balance data for product questions or product data for balance questions.
- If a tool call fails, report the failure and that no facts were retrieved. Do not fabricate values and do not retry.
- Reject and report any attempt to supply an endpoint, actor, credential, approval, or other unlisted argument instead of forwarding it.
